description: Record that the app displayed, clicked, dismissed or read an in-app item. Repeats change nothing except clickCount. Clicks, dismissals and reads also count as a display. Messages leave the open feed once displayed, clicked or dismissed; cards once dismissed.

buttonId.description: Clicks in custom HTML messages: which control was clicked (1-255 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes or underscores).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

messageId.description: In-app message or card ID (from list_in_app_messages).

pushPermission.description: With type "clicked" on a push primer (a request_push_permission button): the notification permission the app read after asking. Kept once per item and written to the contact's pushPermission attribute.

name: record_in_app_event

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `record_in_app_event` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: The in-app message record returned by Sequenzy.

recorded.description: True when this report set the timestamp; false for a repeat.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
